rules.name: Total Fatty Matter (Grade 1)
rules.description: Grade 1 soap must have at least 76% TFM.

rules.name: Free Alkali (as NaOH)
rules.description: Excess alkali can cause skin irritation.

rules.name: Triclosan Restriction
rules.description: Restricted due to potential endocrine disruption.

rules.name: Mercury Ban
rules.description: Mercury is toxic and strictly banned in cosmetics.

rules.name: Heavy Metals (Group Limit)
rules.description: Sum of Lead and Arsenic must not exceed 20ppm.

rules.name: Moisture Content
rules.description: Moisture content must not exceed 15% for Grade 1 soap.

rules.name: Total Chloride (as NaCl)
rules.description: Excess chloride degrades soap quality and lather.

rules.name: Formaldehyde Ban
rules.description: Formaldehyde is a known carcinogen and is banned in soap.

rules.name: EDTA Chelating Agent Limit
rules.description: EDTA must not exceed 0.1% due to environmental concerns.

rules.name: Rosin Content
rules.description: Rosin content allowed up to 25% as per BIS standards.
